title: 2026/2027 Admissions Now Open
author: School Admin
excerpt: Applications for the new academic year are now open. Here's everything parents need to know before applying.
content: ViviChild Academy is now accepting applications for the 2026/2027 academic year across Early Childhood Education, Nursery, Kindergarten and Basic Education.
Parents are encouraged to begin the admissions process early — start with an enquiry, schedule a visit, and our admissions team will guide you through the remaining steps.
Spaces are limited, and enquiries are handled on a first-come basis. Reach out by phone, WhatsApp or the enquiry form to secure your child's place.
metadesc: Apply now for ViviChild Academy's 2026/2027 admissions. Limited spaces are available.

title: Annual Graduation Ceremony Highlights
author: School Admin
excerpt: A look back at this year's graduation ceremony and our proudest moments with the class of 2026.
content: This year's graduation ceremony brought together learners, teachers and families to celebrate a year of growth, learning and achievement.
Graduating pupils were recognised for their academic progress, character development and contribution to school life, before moving on to the next stage of their education.
We are proud of every child who crossed the stage this year, and grateful to the parents and teachers who supported them along the way.
metadesc: Read the highlights from ViviChild Academy's 2026 graduation ceremony.

title: Preparing Your Child for Kindergarten
author: School Admin
excerpt: Practical tips for parents on helping children transition smoothly into kindergarten.
content: Starting kindergarten is a big step for young children, and a little preparation at home can make the transition much smoother.
Simple routines — a consistent bedtime, practising getting dressed independently, and talking positively about school — help children feel confident and ready.
Our teachers are always happy to talk through any concerns parents have before their child's first day. Reach out to our admissions team any time.
metadesc: Tips for parents to help their child transition to kindergarten successfully.

title: School Summer Camp 2026
author: School Admin
excerpt: Join us for a fun-filled summer camp with educational and recreational activities for children of all ages.
content: Our 2026 Summer Camp is designed to provide children with a safe, engaging and educational environment during the school break.
Activities include arts and crafts, sports, music, and science experiments, all supervised by our experienced staff.
Spaces are limited, so early registration is recommended. Contact our admissions team to secure your child's spot.
metadesc: Enroll your child in ViviChild Academy's 2026 Summer Camp for fun and learning.

title: Parent-Teacher Conference 2026
author: School Admin
excerpt: Join us for our annual Parent-Teacher Conference to discuss your child's progress and development.
content: The Parent-Teacher Conference is an important opportunity for parents to meet with teachers and discuss their child's academic performance, social development, and any concerns.
We encourage all parents to attend and actively participate in the discussions about their child's education.
Please schedule your appointment with the admissions team to ensure a convenient time slot.
metadesc: Attend ViviChild Academy's 2026 Parent-Teacher Conference to discuss your child's progress.
